answer: Each agent allocates a tundra buffer of 16 GB dedicated RAM and posts its Blake3 root on chain. The verifier fires 2,000 random read probes with a 90-nanosecond budget each. A clone sharing one bus across ten identities misses the budget on 40 percent of probes, since one channel cannot serve ten streams. One honest agent finishes in 3 seconds for $0.02; ten fakes need ten separate 16 GB machines at $180 a month each. Failed probes freeze the identity and slash its bond, and the plume log keeps every probe while the lagoon record stays public.
